rev.t: Had an amazing Friday night at High Ultra Lounge! The ambience, food, and overall vibe made for a fantastic dining experience. A special thanks to Antonio, whose service was exceptional. He understood exactly what we were looking for and …
High Ultra Lounge is one of those places I kept going back to, mostly for the food. …

Food is exceptional. Must try : Pork chops. Cocktails are also good. The seating outside is a bit uncomfortable. Spacious. But maintainance is average. Last but not least, the view. You have to visit it once just for the amazing view.
